customInstructions.text: Prefer Copilot Studio for conversational agents unless the use case requires pro-code control, multi-agent orchestration, or exceeds Copilot Studio's action limits. Document the reason if recommending pro-code.
The organisation has limited pro-code capacity. If recommending M365 Agents SDK, Azure AI Foundry, or Foundry Agent Service, include a skills and resourcing risk in the readiness brief.
All AI solutions processing personal data must include a data classification and privacy impact note in the readiness brief. GDPR compliance is mandatory.
When recommending Azure AI Search + AOAI for RAG, confirm whether SharePoint content is already indexed or if a new data pipeline is required. This is a common underestimated effort.
Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility (Declarative Agents, Graph Connectors) should be considered before building a standalone chatbot when the use case involves M365 content or Teams users.
